data.title: SYMPHONY and Huawei Sign MOU
data.description: SYMPHONY Communication Public Company Limited and Huawei Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to establish a framework for strategic and technical cooperation. The agreement covers six areas of collaboration including intelligent network evolution, optical transport network development, virtualization platform and storage infrastructure, AI infrastructure innovation, intelligent operations and maintenance (O&M) services, and joint talent development — laying the groundwork for SYMPHONY to strengthen its network capabilities and accelerate its digital transformation journey.
